attchmntText: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: Vodafone Idea Limited announced a change in its Independent Director on 12 November 2026. Mr. Sunirmal Talukdar, DIN 00920608, will cease to be an Independent Director with effect from the close of business hours on 5 December 2026, following the completion of his tenure. The Board appointed Dr. V S Parthasarathy, DIN 00125299, as an Additional Director qualifying as an Independent Director. This appointment is effective from 6 December 2026 to 5 December 2031. The appointment is subject to the approval of the Members of the Company. Dr. Parthasarathy is aged 64 years and has over 40 years of experience. He is not related to any Director of the Company.

attchmntText: The Company has informed the Exchange about the Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Vodafone Idea Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The report, issued by Acuité Ratings and Research Limited, details the utilization of proceeds from the preferential issue of convertible warrants. The Audit Committee and Board of Directors considered the report on 12 November 2026. The information is available on the company website at www.myvi.in. The monitoring agency confirmed that the company utilized the proceeds for the intended purposes. The company stated that there is no commitment of creating any charge on the assets. The report was also placed before the Board. The company secretary Pankaj Kapdeo signed the letter.

attchmntText: The Company has informed the exchange regarding Quarterly report for the Second Quarter ended 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Vodafone Idea Limited submitted its quarterly report for the second quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 11,884 Cr and cash EBITDA of Rs. 2,498 Cr for the quarter. The subscriber base increased to 194.4 million, with blended ARPU at Rs. 178. The company recorded a loss after tax of Rs. 5,975 Cr. Capital expenditure for the quarter was Rs. 3,946 Cr. Bank debt stood at Rs. 943 Cr, while cash and bank balances were Rs. 5,470 Cr. The firm secured over Rs. 10,500 Cr in funding till H1FY27.

attchmntText: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at their meeting held on 12 November 2026, inter alia, approved the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30 September 2026.
voiceSummary: Vodafone Idea Limited reported unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 12, 2026. The Group incurred a net loss of Rs. 9,729 Cr for the six months ended September 30, 2026. Net worth stands at negative Rs. 44,298 Cr. Service revenue for the quarter was Rs. 11,835 Cr. Earnings per share were negative Rs. 0.90 for the six-month period. Outstanding debt from banks and debentures is Rs. 4,543 Cr. Deferred payment obligations include Rs. 131,268 Cr for Spectrum and Rs. 26,264 Cr for AGR. The company states it has met all debt obligations to date and is in discussions with banks for additional funds. Financial results were prepared on a going concern basis.

attchmntText: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange about Grant of Stock Options
voiceSummary: Vodafone Idea Limited approved the grant of 95,90,243 stock options on 12 November 2026. This comprises 54,01,545 Options and 41,88,698 Performance Stock Units under the VIL Scheme 2024. The exercise price is Rs. 12.88 per Option based on the market price of 11 November 2026. The price is Rs. 10 per PSU. Each instrument converts into one fully paid-up equity share with a face value of Rs. 10. Options vest at 33% annually over three years. PSUs vest at 100% after three years. The exercise period is five years from the vesting date. The scheme complies with SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity Regulations 2021.

attchmntText: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Analyst/ Institutional Investor Meeting
voiceSummary: Vodafone Idea Limited intimates the schedule for Analyst and Institutional Investor meetings pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. Representatives will participate in the 29th CITIC CLSA India Forum on 16 November 2026 in Mumbai. The company will also attend the JM Financial Annual India Conference India Xchange 2026 on 17 November 2026 in Mumbai. Both events include one-on-one and group sessions. The schedule may change due to exigencies. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these meetings.
